meaning.en: To come up with a clever idea in an emergency.
meaning.zh: 在紧急情况下猛然想出了好办法。

examples.zh: 钥匙锁在车里了，他急中生智，用衣架把门打开了。
examples.en: With the keys locked in the car, he thought fast and opened the door with a coat hanger.

examples.zh: 主持人急中生智，用一个笑话化解了尴尬。
examples.en: The host thought on her feet and defused the awkward moment with a joke.

examples.zh: 小男孩急中生智，大声呼救，吓跑了坏人。
examples.en: The little boy had the presence of mind to shout for help and scared the man off.

meaning.en: To steal what one is entrusted to guard; embezzlement.
meaning.zh: 盗窃自己负责看管的财物。

examples.zh: 仓库管理员监守自盗，被公司开除了。
examples.en: The warehouse keeper was sacked for stealing the stock he was meant to guard.

examples.zh: 这起案件是典型的监守自盗。
examples.en: This case was a classic inside job.

examples.zh: 出纳监守自盗，挪用了上百万公款。
examples.en: The cashier embezzled over a million in public funds.

meaning.en: Two people understand each other perfectly without words.
meaning.zh: 彼此心意相通，不用说出来就能互相理解。

examples.zh: 他们俩心心相印，一个眼神就明白对方的意思。
examples.en: They're so in tune that a single look is enough.

examples.zh: 祝你们心心相印，白头偕老。
examples.en: May you always be of one heart and grow old together.

examples.zh: 多年的老搭档早已心心相印。
examples.en: After years as partners they're on exactly the same wavelength.

synonyms: 身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通

meaning.en: A place blessed with outstanding people and a fine landscape.
meaning.zh: 指杰出的人物出生或到过的地方，成为名胜之地；也指地方好、人才多。

examples.zh: 绍兴人杰地灵，出过许多名人。
examples.en: Shaoxing is a cradle of talent and has produced many famous people.

examples.zh: 这里山清水秀，人杰地灵。
examples.en: It's a beautiful place, rich in talent.

examples.zh: 江南自古人杰地灵。
examples.en: The Jiangnan region has been a land of talent since ancient times.

story.en: Wang Bo praised Hongzhou: 'The people are outstanding and the land is inspired; Xu Ruzi was given a couch by Chen Fan' (人杰地灵，徐孺下陈蕃之榻).
story.zh: 王勃《滕王阁序》：“物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟；人杰地灵，徐孺下陈蕃之榻。”

meaning.en: Unable to act as one wishes; not in control of oneself.
meaning.zh: 身体不由自己做主，指行动不能自主。

examples.zh: 在公司里，很多事情身不由己。
examples.en: At work, a lot of things are out of your hands.

examples.zh: 人在江湖，身不由己。
examples.en: Once you're in the game, you can't always do as you please.

examples.zh: 被人群一挤，我身不由己地往前走。
examples.en: Jostled by the crowd, I was carried forward helplessly.

meaning.en: Too painful to look back on.
meaning.zh: 不忍心回顾过去的事情。

examples.zh: 那段不堪回首的日子终于过去了。
examples.en: Those painful days are finally behind us.

examples.zh: 战争年代的经历让人不堪回首。
examples.en: Memories of the war years are too painful to dwell on.

examples.zh: 那次失败的创业，他至今不堪回首。
examples.en: He still can't bear to think about that failed business.

story.en: The captive last ruler of Southern Tang wrote: 'Under the bright moon I cannot bear to look back on my lost kingdom' (故国不堪回首月明中).
story.zh: 李煜《虞美人》：“小楼昨夜又东风，故国不堪回首月明中。”

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

meaning.en: Birth, ageing, sickness and death: the inevitable course of life.
meaning.zh: 佛教指人生的四苦，泛指人的一生必经的过程。

examples.zh: 生老病死是自然规律。
examples.en: Birth, ageing, sickness and death are the laws of nature.

examples.zh: 当医生久了，见惯了生老病死。
examples.en: After years as a doctor, she's seen every stage of life and death.

examples.zh: 谁也逃不过生老病死。
examples.en: No one escapes the cycle of life.

meaning.en: News of success keeps arriving.
meaning.zh: 胜利的消息不断传来。

examples.zh: 运动会上，我们学校捷报频传。
examples.en: At the sports day our school kept on winning.

examples.zh: 前方捷报频传，大家士气高涨。
examples.en: With victories reported one after another, morale is high.

examples.zh: 今年公司各部门捷报频传。
examples.en: Good news has poured in from every department this year.

meaning.en: To state the main point clearly at the very beginning.
meaning.zh: 说话、写文章一开始就点明主要意思。

equivalents: state the theme at the start

examples.zh: 文章开宗明义，第一段就提出了观点。
examples.en: The essay gets straight to the point, setting out its argument in the first paragraph.

examples.zh: 他开宗明义地说：“今天我们只谈预算。”
examples.en: He began by saying plainly: 'Today we're only discussing the budget.'

examples.zh: 报告开宗明义，指出了问题的严重性。
examples.en: The report states at the outset how serious the problem is.

story.en: The first chapter of the Classic of Filial Piety is titled 'Opening the Theme and Clarifying the Meaning' (开宗明义章), setting out the book's main idea.
story.zh: 《孝经》首章题为“开宗明义章”，开篇即阐明全书宗旨。

meaning.en: Moving people to the depths of their hearts.
meaning.zh: 使人内心深受感动。

examples.zh: 这部电影的结局感人肺腑。
examples.en: The film's ending is deeply moving.

examples.zh: 他在婚礼上的致辞感人肺腑。
examples.en: His wedding speech was heartfelt and moving.

examples.zh: 老师感人肺腑的一番话，让我们都哭了。
examples.en: The teacher's moving words brought us all to tears.

meaning.en: So fresh or pleasant that it seems to soak into one's heart.
meaning.zh: 指吸入芳香清凉的空气或喝了清凉饮料，感到舒适；也比喻优美的诗文、音乐给人清新爽朗的感觉。

examples.zh: 一阵花香飘来，沁人心脾。
examples.en: A waft of flower scent drifted over, wonderfully refreshing.

examples.zh: 山里的空气清新得沁人心脾。
examples.en: The mountain air is invigoratingly fresh.

examples.zh: 这首歌旋律优美，沁人心脾。
examples.en: The melody is beautiful and soothing to the soul.

meaning.en: A meaning implied but not stated.
meaning.zh: 话里没有直接说出来的意思。

examples.zh: 他说“再考虑一下”，言外之意就是不同意。
examples.en: He said 'let me think about it', which really means no.

examples.zh: 你没听出老板的言外之意吗？
examples.en: Didn't you pick up on what the boss was hinting at?

examples.zh: 读诗要体会诗人的言外之意。
examples.en: When reading poetry, you have to read between the lines.

meaning.en: So drowsy one is about to fall asleep.
meaning.zh: 昏昏沉沉，只想睡觉。

examples.zh: 午饭后上课，大家都昏昏欲睡。
examples.en: In the class after lunch everyone was nodding off.

examples.zh: 这场讲座枯燥得让人昏昏欲睡。
examples.en: The lecture was so dull it sent people to sleep.

examples.zh: 吃了感冒药，我一直昏昏欲睡。
examples.en: The cold medicine left me drowsy all day.

meaning.en: Just as expected.
meaning.zh: 没有超出预料。

examples.zh: 不出所料，他又迟到了。
examples.en: As expected, he was late again.

examples.zh: 比赛结果不出所料，主队赢了。
examples.en: Predictably, the home side won.

examples.zh: 销量下滑不出所料，市场早就饱和了。
examples.en: The drop in sales came as no surprise; the market was saturated long ago.

usage.en: Sentence-initial or predicate; can take 我/他: 不出我所料.
usage.zh: 常放句首，也可说“不出我所料”。

meaning.en: Natural and flowing, like drifting clouds and running water (of writing, calligraphy or performance).
meaning.zh: 像飘浮的云和流动的水，比喻诗文、书法或表演自然流畅，不拘束。

examples.zh: 他的文章如行云流水，读起来很舒服。
examples.en: His prose flows so naturally it's a pleasure to read.

examples.zh: 她弹琴如行云流水。
examples.en: Her piano playing is effortless and fluid.

examples.zh: 这套动作做得行云流水。
examples.en: The routine was performed with flowing grace.

story.en: Su Shi praised a friend's writing as 'like drifting clouds and flowing water, with no fixed form, moving where it should and stopping where it must'.
story.zh: 苏轼《与谢民师推官书》：“大略如行云流水，初无定质，但常行于所当行，常止于所不可不止。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“如行云流水”。

meaning.en: Poor and backward, starting from almost nothing.
meaning.zh: 指基础差，底子薄（穷：经济落后；白：文化科学落后）。

examples.zh: 新中国成立时，国家一穷二白。
examples.en: When the People's Republic was founded, the country was poor and backward.

examples.zh: 我们是在一穷二白的基础上建起这家工厂的。
examples.en: We built this factory up from nothing.

examples.zh: 刚毕业时我一穷二白，什么都没有。
examples.en: When I graduated I had absolutely nothing.

origin.source: 毛泽东《介绍一个合作社》

story.en: Mao Zedong (1958): 'The outstanding feature of China's 600 million people is that they are poor and blank' (一穷二白), arguing this made them eager for change.
story.zh: 毛泽东《介绍一个合作社》：“中国六亿人口的显著特点是一穷二白。”

meaning.en: Afraid of nothing.
meaning.zh: 什么都不怕。

examples.zh: 消防员无所畏惧地冲进火场。
examples.en: The firefighters charged fearlessly into the blaze.

examples.zh: 年轻人就该无所畏惧，敢闯敢拼。
examples.en: Young people should be fearless and willing to take risks.

examples.zh: 面对强大的对手，他们无所畏惧。
examples.en: They were undaunted by their powerful opponents.

synonyms: 死猪不怕开水烫——满不在乎
antonyms: 吹口哨过坟场——自己给自己壮胆

meaning.en: To rise above others; to make a name for oneself.
meaning.zh: 超出一般人，高人一等。

examples.zh: 父母拼命工作，就是希望孩子将来能出人头地。
examples.en: The parents work hard so their children can make something of themselves.

examples.zh: 他一心想出人头地。
examples.en: He's desperate to get ahead.

examples.zh: 从小村子出来的她，终于出人头地了。
examples.en: The girl from a tiny village has finally made it.

story.en: On reading the young Su Shi, Ouyang Xiu said: 'This old man should step aside and let him stand a head above others' (放他出一头地).
story.zh: 欧阳修《与梅圣俞书》：“读轼书，不觉汗出，快哉！快哉！老夫当避路，放他出一头地也。”

meaning.en: Without any scruples or hesitation.
meaning.zh: 没有什么顾虑和忌讳。

examples.zh: 他喝醉以后说话无所顾忌。
examples.en: When he's drunk he says whatever comes into his head.

examples.zh: 孩子们在草地上无所顾忌地奔跑。
examples.en: The children ran about the lawn without a care.

examples.zh: 这些商家无所顾忌地抬高价格。
examples.en: These traders hiked their prices without any scruple.

meaning.en: Pain one feels personally and acutely.
meaning.zh: 切身感受到的痛苦。

examples.zh: 只有经历过失业，才懂那种切肤之痛。
examples.en: Only someone who has lost their job knows how that really hurts.

examples.zh: 战争给这里的人们带来了切肤之痛。
examples.en: The war brought bitter suffering to everyone here.

examples.zh: 他对污染有切肤之痛，因为家乡的河被毁了。
examples.en: Pollution hits close to home for him, because the river where he grew up was ruined.

meaning.en: A newborn's innocent heart; pure sincerity, often of devotion to one's country.
meaning.zh: 婴儿般纯洁的心，比喻人心地纯洁善良；也指对祖国的赤诚。

examples.zh: 他已经八十岁了，却依然保持着一颗赤子之心。
examples.en: At eighty he still has a pure, childlike heart.

examples.zh: 海外游子怀着赤子之心报效祖国。
examples.en: Overseas Chinese served their homeland with sincere devotion.

examples.zh: 艺术家最可贵的是赤子之心。
examples.en: An artist's most precious asset is an innocent heart.

story.en: Mencius: 'The great man is one who has not lost the heart of a newborn child' (不失其赤子之心者也).
story.zh: 《孟子·离娄下》：“大人者，不失其赤子之心者也。”

usage.en: Object; often 一颗赤子之心.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“一颗赤子之心”。

meaning.en: To slap the table and shout in admiration.
meaning.zh: 拍着桌子叫好，形容非常赞赏。

examples.zh: 这篇小说构思巧妙，让人拍案叫绝。
examples.en: The novel's plot is so ingenious it makes you want to applaud.

examples.zh: 他的解题方法令老师拍案叫绝。
examples.en: His solution had the teacher marvelling.

examples.zh: 这个创意让评委们拍案叫绝。
examples.en: The idea had the judges raving.

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人/让人拍案叫绝.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人拍案叫绝”。

meaning.en: The entire nation, from top to bottom.
meaning.zh: 全国上上下下。

examples.zh: 夺冠的消息传来，举国上下一片欢腾。
examples.en: When news of the title came, the whole nation erupted in joy.

examples.zh: 举国上下都在关注这次救援行动。
examples.en: The rescue is being followed up and down the country.

examples.zh: 疫情期间，举国上下齐心抗疫。
examples.en: During the pandemic, the whole country pulled together.

meaning.en: A change in name or form only, with nothing changed in substance.
meaning.zh: 比喻只改变形式，不改变内容。

equivalents: the same thing in a new wrapper

examples.zh: 所谓的改革只是换汤不换药。
examples.en: The so-called reform is just old wine in new bottles.

examples.zh: 这款新手机换汤不换药，跟去年的几乎一样。
examples.en: The new phone is just a repackaged version of last year's.

examples.zh: 公司换了个名字，可还是换汤不换药。
examples.en: The company changed its name, but nothing else changed.

meaning.en: Thick with smoke and foul air; figuratively, chaotic and corrupt.
meaning.zh: 形容空气污浊，也比喻环境嘈杂、秩序混乱或社会黑暗。

examples.zh: 办公室被他搞得乌烟瘴气。
examples.en: He's turned the office into a toxic place.

examples.zh: 网吧里乌烟瘴气，到处是烟味。
examples.en: The internet café was thick with stale smoke.

examples.zh: 那个部门乌烟瘴气，没人好好干活。
examples.en: That department is a mess; nobody does any proper work.
